decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line highlight [ev-a94d677cfc9f]. It announces an opt-in capability, global SOPS Age decryption keys for Kustomization on single-tenant clusters, but does not name the controller flag, secret or field that turns it on. Flagging every environment that uses kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 Kustomization is broader than what the evidence supports, because nothing says existing Kustomizations change unless an operator adopts the feature. P2's field spec.decryption.sopsAgeKeys was also refuted against the CRD schemas [ev-782bc47d120d][ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. To decide the exposure we need the upgrade-guide or controller documentation that names how global Age keys are configured, and whether the single-tenant condition depends on a setting such as multi-tenancy lockdown.
